propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit silently on success, making successful writes and idempotent no-ops indistinguishable on stdout, forcing agents to issue follow-up show commands for verification

Verbs must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmations in past-tense format (e.g. 'linked src -> target') for writes and 'no change: reason' for idempotent no-ops, with consumed seam return contracts (like add_dependency's dict | None REDIRECT) left unchanged

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with --output json producing a single mutation envelope and --quiet suppressing text confirmations only

Existing REDIRECT record emission from link must remain byte-identical in both text and --output json modes, with no additional confirmation line overlaid, and --quiet must not suppress machine-readable records

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving all prior output data, and transition's UNBLOCKED ids must remain visible in the new line
